description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter app named 'Local Wallet'. It sets up the MaterialApp with theming, a bottom navigation bar with three tabs (Home, Transactions, Categories), and a floating action button to add transactions via a bottom sheet. It acts as the root widget managing navigation and theming for the app.

classes.name: WalletApp
classes.description: The root widget acting as the entry point of the Flutter application, setting up MaterialApp, theming, and main navigation structure.

classes.name: _WalletAppState
classes.description: State class managing current tab index, navigation, and bottom sheet interactions for WalletApp.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for WalletApp.

methods.name: _onTabTap
methods.description: Updates current tab index when a navigation destination is selected.

methods.name: _onFabPressed
methods.description: Handles the floating action button press to show a bottom sheet for adding transactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire widget tree, including MaterialApp, Scaffold, AppBar, bottom navigation, and FAB.
